provider: Illustrative mapping prepared by the gateway operator, Andrei Besleaga, from the reporting subject's own published Impact Report 2025 (figures for calendar year 2024); NOT published, reviewed, authorized, or endorsed by the reporting subject. Every figure is read from the source document named in methodology-uri. Scope caveats: Location-based basis, as published; carbon-footprint is the table's printed total (18,284 tCO2e) and equals the sum of the three scope members. The same report also prints 118,284 in a summary tile; the table's figure is used because its three scope figures add up to it. energy-consumption is the report's key figure for electricity consumption. renewable-energy is the report's 100% figure for data-centre energy, which the report bases on Guarantees of Origin.
